string.text: Optional links between player stamina use and survival needs. All options here are off by default.

How much losing stamina increases dehydration. 0 = off (vanilla thirst only). Requires thirst gameplay enabled in difficulty settings. Higher values make sprinting and heavy load drain hydration faster.
How much losing stamina increases hunger. 0 = off (vanilla satiety only). Higher values make sprinting and heavy load drain satiety faster.
Scales how quickly bleeding drains the actor's health. 1.0 = vanilla. Higher values make open wounds more lethal.
Multiplies bleed health loss on the player. Range 1.0 (vanilla) to 3.0 (triple damage).
Scales how quickly open wounds clot and stop bleeding on their own. 1.0 = vanilla. Higher values heal bleeds faster; lower values slow natural recovery.
